text: Phase 3 complete via test-harden agent. 1024 pass / 0 fail / 2 benign skips. All unseeded RNG seeded (in-block); 1e-9/1e-10 tolerances relaxed to principled 1e-6/1e-8 with shared align_signs() helper; genpca_cov family ~34 sites; test_gep_subspace rewritten with Cholesky-whitened symmetric reference (was tolerance=0.3 vacuous); dead skip fixed (randomized dispatch test now runs); skip_on_cran removed from primary eigen-vs-spectra equivalence test; new test-phase3-hardening.R (51 assertions) pins all Phase 1 bug fixes + rpls/truncate/transfer/randomized-determinism behavior. FINDING: gpca_mle loglik_path genuinely non-monotone (ridge + trace/det renorm + truncation) - to be documented as diagnostic, not fixed algorithmically, for 0.1.0.
